## Button
**Node ID:** 1531:25362

Shared flat source for labelled and icon-only buttons. Hierarchy, Tone and State are direct properties. Size and Theme use modes; Width uses native Hug/Fill resizing. Icons use icon breakpoints → Base Scale. Layout direction: LTR or RTL. Leading/trailing slots follow reading direction. Text and icon artwork remain upright. Direction is independent of theme and state. RTL guide and connected examples: https://www.figma.com/design/rkJclvwYpmw9ja5vUwkl3P?node-id=2400-9990 Neutral tone uses existing semantic action/neutral and action/neutral-foreground colors. Use Neutral for notification actions so brand and feedback colors retain their meaning. Available across all five hierarchies, five states and both directions.

## Action icon / chevron-down
**Node ID:** 906:5841

Lucide chevron-down with semantic action foreground. Inherits style/tone/state from action components; neutral text color outside actions.
